messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["rotate injection sites with each dose", "remove needle after each injection", "use new needle for each injection", "measure each dose with the oral dosing syringe", "remove and safely discard needle after each injection", "treatment with methylene blue injection", "injection", "use an injection on the same day each week", "4 weeks after each dose change", "allows taking smaller amount at each dose", "once-weekly injection", "single-patient-use injection", "each trimester", "injection only", "subcutaneous injection", "intravenous injection"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
